def fix_romanian(text: str) -> str:
    mapping = str.maketrans({
        "ş": "ș",
        "Ş": "Ș",
        "ţ": "ț",
        "Ţ": "Ț",
    })
    text = text.translate(mapping)

    replacements = {
        "s\u0327": "ș",
        "S\u0327": "Ș",
        "t\u0327": "ț",
        "T\u0327": "Ț",
        "s\u0326": "ș",
        "S\u0326": "Ș",
        "t\u0326": "ț",
        "T\u0326": "Ț",
    }

    for old, new in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(old, new)

    return text
